paragraphs: Rav Yechezkel, Rav Yehudah’s father. Rav Yechezkel recited: Berakhot 11a. He taught his son Rami, and so forth. Rav Yehudah told him: ‘Father, do not teach thus.’ Rav Shmuel told him: ‘Do not speak thus to your father’: HaNisrafin 80b and Kiddushin 32a. Rav Yehudah was his father’s teacher. Shmuel told him to rise before his father because he was a man of deeds; Shmuel too rose before him: Kiddushin 33b.
